'''Redwall Keep''' is an abandoned keep located in the canyons east of [[Stonewatch Falls]] in the [[Redridge Mountains]], on the mountainside overlooking the [[Swamp of Sorrows]].

==Trivia==
* Redwall Keep was intended to serve as a world PvP objective.
